notes.title: Candyboy Is Free To Play (Soon)
notes.notes:
Hello,

Candyboy is becoming free to play soon. I'm going to send the price change to Steam support and wait for approval, and this announcement is just a heads up not to buy a game that will become entirely free soon.

Thanks to everyone who paid for the project, and I'll be certain to make the next one much better. This was a small passion project through and through, and the support I did get from it was really cool.

In the meantime, feel free to get the game on Itch.io, since it'll be fully free there during the Steam price change wait.

Take care in the meantime,
Staring Skull Studios
